data.one_liner: Set or clear system proxy on Windows, Linux, and macOS from Dart code
data.what_it_does: The package exposes a ProxyManager that can configure the system proxy settings for desktop platforms. It supports HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS proxies and can also clean the proxy configuration.
use_when: Configuring a corporate proxy for a desktop Flutter app
Running integration tests that require a specific proxy
Developing a tool that needs to switch proxies at runtime
avoid_when: Building a mobile app that needs proxy support
Using a proxy only for a single HTTP request
Relying on a third‑party proxy service that handles configuration automatically
strengths: No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: No support for mobile or web
